title: When the context default value is used

slides.text: The default is a last resort 🛟
slides.say: The default value you pass to create context is a last resort fallback. Here is exactly when it applies.
Only if there is no matching provider above at all does use context return the default. It is static and never changes.
The trap: a provider without a value prop counts as value undefined. So Button gets undefined, not light. Same if you misname the prop.

slides.text: Want it to change? Pair the provider with state.
slides.say: And because the default never changes, put state in a provider when you need the value to update.
